_readme: EDIT THIS FILE to manage your store. price is in CENTS. stock: 0 = sold out, 1-5 = 'low stock' badge. dropAt (ISO date) locks the product until that moment. images: put real WebP files in /public/img and list them as ['/img/hoodie-1.webp', ...]. If images is empty, a generated placeholder is drawn. The checkout server (api/create-checkout-session.js) reads this SAME file to validate prices, so you only edit prices here.

products.name: Static Heavyweight Hoodie
products.description: 450gsm fleece, boxy fit, dropped shoulders. Washed black with a cracked puff print across the chest. Pre-shrunk and built to be worn to death.
details: Cracked puff print, front and back
Unisex, runs large: size down for a normal fit

products.name: Ash Boxy Tee
products.description: Heavy 240gsm cotton in faded ash grey. Oversized boxy cut with a raw hem and a distressed graphic on the back.
details: Garment dyed: each piece fades differently

products.name: Night Shift Long Sleeve
products.description: Long sleeve with sleeve prints and a small chest hit. Made for 3am studio sessions and cold bus stops.

products.name: Soot Beanie
products.description: Tight-knit fisherman beanie with a woven patch. One size, pulls down low.

products.name: Carbon Tote
products.description: Heavy canvas tote with reinforced handles and an inside pocket. Fits records, a laptop, or a whole bad decision.

products.name: Residue Sticker Pack
products.description: Six die-cut vinyl stickers. Waterproof, scratch-proof, and impossible to peel off cleanly.

products.name: Fog Poster
products.description: 18 x 24 in poster on heavy matte stock. Black ink on smoke grey, shipped flat in a tube.

products.name: Tour Crew Jacket
products.description: Limited run coach jacket with an embroidered back piece and numbered inside tag. Once this batch is gone, it is gone.
